text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while dropping by an arcade...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno!
What in the world happened to you?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I heard the rumors! That lately,
you've been hanging out at the arcade non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You, who used to spend every spare moment training!
I can only assume something terrible must have happened!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me, Yaeno...
have you turned delinquent on us?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Bamboo-san.
That is utterly out of the question.
Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is no mere idle play to me...
It is ascetic training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Training...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing is believing.
I believe it would be best for you to witness an actual game... no,
a 'match' firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Doryaryaryarya!
Haah! Seiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Not quite! Hmph, hah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, t-this is...!
Not just fierce assaults, but both sides are constantly
aiming for a counter...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. What decides victory in fighting games is
'Sen no Sen'—relentless combos that give no quarter...
And 'Go no Sen'—the decisive counter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!
In racing terms, that's kind of like 'Front Runner' and 'Late Surger'!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, is it really okay to look away right now?!
Shaah! Iron Core Explosive Shatter Kick!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aahh, t-this is bad!
Your HP is almost gone!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to wrap this up with the finishing blow!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—A path forward can only be found in the jaws of death!
Here is my chance!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-... What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I... I can see it! I can see it!
Behind Yaeno...
is a boundless, endless wasteland!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Cyber Yaegaki Style:
Great Mountain Waterfall Drop!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ooooh!
A comeback victory!!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You've gotten better, Yaeno-chan.
That was a good fight... Smell ya later.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome, Yaeno!
What a heated battle!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It seems the profound depth of combat has reached you as well, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...To tell the truth, I once considered video games to be nothing more than trivial pastimes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, after a classmate brought me to this arcade,
I realized the narrowness of my own worldview.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is a place to hone one's skills, clash with mighty warriors, sharpen one another,
and elevate oneself... Indeed, it is.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohh... So it's just like a dojo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Martial arts, racing, video games... Whatever it may be,
so long as one regards it as such, a path to mastery will reveal itself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And... what is gained here will surely prove useful on other paths as well!
That is the conviction I strive under.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~! ...Whoaaa!
Now I kinda wanna fight too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then allow me to be your opponent.
Come, step up to that cabinet over there.
